import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sin(p[9]*t); c=np.cos(p[9]*t)
    return p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*t**2+p[3]*s+p[4]*c+P*(p[5]+p[6]*s+p[7]*c)+p[8]*P**2
